notes.title: PATCH 1.6.4
notes.notes:
[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
- Improved Hitreg
- Platform requirements 13+

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
- Fixed memory issue
- Fixed issues in Trials
- Fixed trial UI appearing on scene load (without adversary)
- Visual and stability issues
- Sword gauge UI fix
- Many Ronin fixes
- Many optimization

[h2]BALANCING[/h2]
- [b]Nerf[/b]: Duelist, Viking & Pirate
- [b]Buff[/b]: Persian, Samurai, Knight & Ronin

[h3]Nerf[/h3]
- [b]Vik L[/b]: -5A (162)
- [b]Duelist L[/b]: -5A (185)
- [b]Pirate M[/b]: -5A (160)
- [b]Barb M[/b]: -3A (178) +100ms Awaken in respite (250ms)
- [b]Barb L[/b]: -2A (182) +100ms Awaken in respite (250ms)

[h3]Buff[/h3]
- [b]Persian M[/b]: +5A (183) +0.1 Speed (4.35-10.75)
- [b]Persian L[/b]: +3A (182) +0.05 Speed (3.75-10.55)
- [b]Sam M[/b]: +5A (195)
- [b]Sam L[/b]: +2A (192)
- [b]Ronin M[/b]: +2A (182)
- [b]Ronin L[/b]: +5A (195)
- [b]Knight M[/b]: +4A (181)
- [b]Knight L[/b]: +1A (181)

[b]Persian[/b]: The edge bonus will be reduced by 25% on main blade to favor the cats claw.
[b]Barbarian (main)[/b]: Speed remains unchanged, but adjustments have been made to the respite (when the player loses awaken, there is now a 1/10 second delay before the blade can be awakened again), making it slightly less forgiving. It penalizes players if they lose awaken.
[b]Note[/b]: "L" is for Legendary, "M" is for Main.

notes.title: Onboarding Improvement patch!
notes.notes:
[h3]FIRST BLADE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Default blade, easier/weaker Awaken (low speed only)
[*] Targets new players, easier to learn other game mechanics (before focusing on Awaken)
[*] Main unlocked at level 3 (previously first blade)
[*] Legendary unlocked at level 15 (previously 10)
[*] First Blade replace Legacy (underused), same visual.
[/list]

[h3]TRIALS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trials are challenges that aim at orienting player toward how to play their character
[*] Winning trial with good score give a lot of XP, making blade progression easier
[*] Added the Trials mode in Dojo and before Ranked match (replace Training)
[/list]

[h3]PERFORMANCE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Better networking (should make low lag game feel a bit more smooth)
[/list]

[h3]SOLO[/h3]
[list]
[*] Viking, Pirate and Ronin can now be adversaries in Solo
[*] Reworked fighting behavior (more diversity, adjusted difficulty)
[*] Menu flow slightly improved
[*] Animations now blend between each other
[*] Opponent orient itself toward the player
[*] Apprentice mode was made easier and to feel more like a real match
[/list]

[h3]IK[/h3]
[list]
[*] Better character IK mean body position is better oriented with head and hands
[/list]

[h3]DOJO[/h3]
[list]
[*] Menu flow slightly improved
[*] Can now skip some Tutorial sequence
[/list]

[h3]PROGRESSION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added UI to see progression toward next sword (only in trials)
[/list]

notes.title: Ronin Update is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greeting, fearless warriors![/h1]

Get ready to unsheathe your excitement, because a thrilling new update is now LIVE on Broken Edge! As the shadows lengthen, a subtle rustle stirs through the bamboo groves – a whisper that heralds the arrival of a new fighter, a lone wanderer whose skills are as sharp as his katana.

Embark on a journey back to the land of the rising sun with this new free update! ⛩️ Discover all the details in the breakdown below:


[h2]What's new?[/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]The Ronin[/h3]
Once a devoted Samurai, this new fighter now roams through cities and countryside in search of worthy adversaries. With a sheath as his ally and a katana as his soulmate, the Ronin brings a unique martial style to learn and master. His mechanics of combat are inspired by anime sword fighting. So, get ready to feel cool as you unsheathe your blade  and slice through your opponent in the blink of an eye. Omae wa mou shindeiru!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/4223ab183406e9678ae7b976a9a3f39b82f71fa5.png[/img]

[*] [h3]New Arena[/h3]
Fight like no other in a shrine hidden deep within the heart of a forest. Let the rustling bamboo and the full moon bear witness to your victories, as you carve your path to glory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/a15441f0a37686a8c2a0134baeebbd5eb50661a6.png[/img]

[/list]
Join our [url=http://discord.gg/brokenedge]Discord server [/url] to connect with other players, share your strategies, and stay up-to-date on the latest news. You can also join a guild, participate in Leagues, and maybe reach the Tournaments! 

The path of the Ronin is yours to tread – will you rise to the challenge? Sharpen your blade, and let your journey begin! ⚔️

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the patch 1.1.1 that concludes 2022! To prepare for the new year we are fixing some features and adding tools to identify the origin of the latency issue. We can assure you, we are working hard on it to guarantee that only your skills will lead you to victory!  

Thanks for this amazing launch and we’re looking forward to dueling you in 2023! 

[b]Balancing[/b]
[u]Tyrant[/u]
The Tyrant is a formidable fighter… but he deserves to become even more frightful!
	Buff:  + 10 awaken

[u]Knight[/u]
We may have overbuffed the Knight during the last update! Time to blunt his blade a little bit.
Nerf: Threshold to maintain awaken becomes more demanding

[b]Integration of latency (ping) investigation tools[/b]
To fight against the lagging problem, we’re implementing tools to identify the reasons behind this issue. We’ll be able to collect additional games’ data and analyze them in order to fix the latency as soon as possible!  

[b]Calibration[/b]
Players can no more artificially extend their arms during the calibration phase. That will help to prevent cheating or trolling tactics. 

[b]ELO Improvement[/b]
We modified the Elo so it won’t become negative but stop at 0. Every player above 2500 Elo will be reset to 2500 Elo.
We made some adjustments to the rating algorithm. These changes will affect   matches with a high Elo difference. This means that the amount of points you gain/lose will be way more affected by the Elo difference between you and your opponent than before.
